message.content: {"answer": "No, you cannot accept payments while your Wix Payments account is still under verification. If your account status is \"Under Verification\" or \"Accepting Payments\" (but not fully verified), you must complete the setup and verification process before payments can be processed. You have 30 days from the first transaction to finish verification; otherwise, your account will be suspended.", "citations": ["b6c9353c04f2a5e3907ffad8c44109b18c32fbce3efd1a25a7ad0ea9897cb5e1", "3b3edb8700d3099ded98be8cb0c41785b964f5fc4c21db11cd1c6f96250b8f51"]}
